richiami.difetto: Because the glass fitted to the oven door was not correctly treated the glass if broken will break into large pieces instead of small pieces. It is thought that the larger shards are potentially dangerous.
richiami.rimedio: Affected ovens will have the doors replaced.
richiami.titolo: OVEN DOOR MAY NOT BE TEMPERED CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The fridge vent compartment may not have the correct sealing panel fitted.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected caravans to check for fitment of sealing panel.  If one is not fitted a new panel will be fitted.

richiami.difetto: It has been recorded that a small number of instances have occurred where cracks have appeared in the wheel rim with the potential to cause deflation of the tyre.
richiami.rimedio: Wheels which have the potential to suffer this concern will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL DISHES MAY CRACK POTENTIAL  LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE

richiami.difetto: Roof light in vehicle overhead cab pod may become detached and possibly be a danger to other road users.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to test and where necessary re-bond the roof light.
richiami.titolo: ROOF LIGHT IN OVERHEAD CAB MAY BECOME DETACHED
